about.title: A peaceful open-air retreat in Aoufous
about.intro: Gite-Camping-Caravaning Hakkou welcomes travellers to a calm and restful place between Erfoud and Errachidia, with 2 guest rooms, caravan and motorhome pitches, and spaces for tents.
about.description: Hospitality, friendliness, and a warm welcome define the place. The manager can show guests the palm grove and kasbah, tea is offered every morning, and shared meals bring life to the campsite throughout the week.
highlights: Harira and concert entertainment on Saturday

reviews.heading: The spirit of the place
reviews.sub: Recent guest impressions from Camping Hakkou.

items.name: FamilyJagers
items.text: What a lovely night we spent at Hakkou! We played music together, shared life experiences, received good tips and advice, and enjoyed a very warm welcome with tea and peanuts. We ordered a tajine meal for 4 which was delicious. We definitely recommend this place, do not hesitate to pass by. Warm regards Pieter, Ellen, Noah and William.

items.name: riri40
items.text: Superb welcome. Amad and his brother Mustapha will do everything to make sure you are satisfied. The campsite is restful and we will come back. Anabela and Eric.

items.name: Mac22
items.text: A true and authentic welcome. Thank you Amad and your whole team. Jerome (bebert the camel!)

items.name: akwein
items.text: A very beautiful campsite with friendly staff.

items.name: eric87
items.text: A stop not to be missed before Merzouga. Ahmad and his family do everything for you: overnight stay, meals, and visits at a fair price, plus bread baked on a wood fire. A wonderful encounter. We will surely come back.

sections.p: Gite-Camping-Caravaning Hakkou is a peaceful open-air place with 2 guest rooms, pitches for caravans and motorhomes, and spaces for tents.
Hospitality, friendliness, and a relaxed atmosphere define the place. Friendly tea is offered every morning, with regular shared meals and entertainment.
Collective couscous on Friday, Harira on Saturday with concert entertainment, and catering on request for travellers needing meals.
The campsite offers guided visits, picnics, airport transportation, and can help arrange an excursion toward Merzouga.
